lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized into roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with 3 to 5 nodes per visible vertical series along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity circular blobs are situated at the intersections of distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity and faint horizontal planes, creating a series of coordinate-like anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent horizontal ridge feature visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light on the dorsal edge to dark shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of smaller, medium-luminance circular blobs concentrated primarily along the lower half and leading edge of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A white, linear artificial tag or external attachment is visible protruding from the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
